name: SikaProof Bentonite Paste
paste:
SIKAPROOF® BENTONITE PASTE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaProof® Bentonite Paste, April 2023, Version 02.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sikaproof-bentonitepaste.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaProof® Bentonite Paste where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaProof® Bentonite Paste is a one component paste that forms part of the SikaProof® Bentonite natural sodium bentonite below ground waterproofing system. An efficient, dual purpose bentonite formulation which penetrates into the pores of the SikaProof® Bentonite geotextile layers while providing a thick and substantial hydraulic barrier.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. To form watertight overlaps during the installation of SikaProof® Bentonite geotextile roll.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaProof® Bentonite Paste
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Joining paste for use with the SikaProof® Benontite System
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Pre-hydrated and workable
    - Easily troweled
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Light pink - off white paste
2.5 System structure. SikaProof® Bentonite Paste is part of the SikaProof® Bentonite System, comprising of:
    - SikaProof® Bentonite 1.1m wide x 10m roll
    - SikaProof® Bentonite 2.2m wide x 10m roll
    - SikaProof® Bentonite Paste 20 litre pails
    - SikaProof® Bentonite Powder 25 kg bags
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20 litres
    - Shelf life: Three (3) years from date of manufacture if stored correctly.
2.7 Storage conditions. Store in a cool, dry, well-ventilated area, out of direct sunlight. Store in suitable, labelled containers. Keep containers tightly closed. Store away from incompatible materials. Ensure that storage conditions comply with applicable local and national regulations. Protect from freezing.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Instructions. Refer to the SikaProof® Bentonite system data sheet and Method Statement for full installation instructions. Note: SikaProof® Bentonite Paste can only be installed by Sika NZ Approved Contractors.
4.3 Further information - For further information please refer to.
    - SikaProof® Bentonite system data sheet
    - SikaProof® Bentonite Method Statement
    - SikaProof® Bentonite Manual
    - SikaProof® Bentonite BRANZ Appraisal No. 612 [2007]

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaProof® Bentonite Paste, April 2023, Version 02.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sikaproof-bentonitepaste.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaProof Bentonite Paste, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/MSDS%20SikaProof%20Bentonite%20Paste%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
